system_requirements.title: Operating modes
system_requirements.statement: The system shall support continuing observation both before an external task and while pursuing a supplied goal.

system_requirements.title: Heterogeneous information
system_requirements.statement: The system shall accept source-native digitally supplied information through extensible interfaces while distinguishing capture, decoding and understanding.

system_requirements.title: Semantic neutrality
system_requirements.statement: The system shall distinguish host/acquisition assumptions and imported knowledge from representations or relationships learned from its own observations.

system_requirements.title: Endogenous representations
system_requirements.statement: The system shall develop and revise representations from allowed observations under declared learning assumptions.

system_requirements.title: Relationship discovery
system_requirements.statement: The system shall form competing testable relationships without promoting unsupported patterns to established laws.

system_requirements.title: Uncertainty
system_requirements.statement: The system shall preserve unknowns and distinguish acquired evidence, reports, interpretations and uncertainty about each.

system_requirements.title: Investigation
system_requirements.statement: The system shall be able to investigate uncertainty by requesting informative observations or permitted interventions.

system_requirements.title: Revision
system_requirements.statement: The system shall revise unsupported beliefs and operational associations when new evidence contradicts them without rewriting acquired evidence.

system_requirements.title: Persistent experience
system_requirements.statement: The system shall retain addressable evidence and identity history across sessions and declared retention periods.

system_requirements.title: Prediction and what-if
system_requirements.statement: The system shall use supported knowledge for prospective prediction and explicitly scoped counterfactual analysis.

system_requirements.title: Transfer
system_requirements.statement: The system shall evaluate whether prior learned structure improves unfamiliar related tasks against strong reset, conventional-memory and unrelated-history controls.

system_requirements.title: Interpretation and proactive findings
system_requirements.statement: The system shall communicate interpretations and strategically useful new findings with evidence and uncertainty, including when no explicit question requested a finding.

system_requirements.title: Resource efficiency
system_requirements.statement: The system shall operate within declared compute, memory, storage, latency and inference budgets and account for complete task costs.

system_requirements.title: Audit and reproducibility
system_requirements.statement: The system shall preserve provenance, versions, decisions and evidence sufficient to reconstruct supported claims.

system_requirements.title: Reliable scalable operation
system_requirements.statement: The system shall provide explicit capacity, durability, recovery and availability guarantees for qualified deployment profiles.

system_requirements.title: Permitted actions and introspection
system_requirements.statement: The system shall distinguish proposed commands, authorized execution, reported acknowledgement, measured outcome and its own operational telemetry.

retained_requirements.title: Continuous extensible intake
retained_requirements.statement: The observation layer shall receive configured live, historical, file and composite inputs without requiring a question or a known semantic class.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Mixed replay continues through goal changes and unknown media types; counts reconcile.

retained_requirements.title: Native fidelity
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve received bytes and exact typed values, including precision, missingness and native structure within declared retention.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Digest/byte comparison and native-value comparisons match all acquired complete and partial payloads.

retained_requirements.title: Source continuity
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall maintain scoped persistent deliverer/producer/channel identities, aliases and acquisition epochs without conflating producer with subject.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Restarts, alias changes, recycled names and moved sensors resolve using dated evidence or explicit unknowns.

retained_requirements.title: Subject association
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall expose evidence-backed subject associations across time/modalities, allowing multiple subjects and unresolved identity.
retained_requirements.acceptance: All supported deterministic bindings match fixture truth; intentionally indistinguishable subjects remain unresolved.

retained_requirements.title: Reversible identity history
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall retain valid-time and recorded-time association assertions and reversible correction/retraction history.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A mistaken association is retracted without changing raw records; historical and current queries return their declared versions.

retained_requirements.title: Time and order
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve source times, clocks, epochs and ordering limits separately from receipt and commit times.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Clock reset, variable sample timing and two-year-late arrivals do not fabricate source order.

retained_requirements.title: Acquired versus derived
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve lineage and distinguish native receipt from transformations, reports, simulations, predictions and model outputs where their origin is known.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Each derived result pins parent/procedure/version; unknown generation method is explicit, not guessed.

retained_requirements.title: Composition and selectors
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall preserve supplied nested composition and address supported parts with revision-specific selectors.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Native container survives; selectors address correct parts/revisions and malformed recursive expansion is bounded.

retained_requirements.title: Unknown and unsupported states
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall capture admitted opaque content while exposing missing, partial, reference-only, unsupported and failed-processing states.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Unknown optional extensions round-trip; unknown required interpretation is unsupported; empty bytes differ from no payload.

retained_requirements.title: Durable commit acknowledgement
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall acknowledge a requested supported durable level only after required payloads and commit metadata meet that level.
retained_requirements.acceptance: No acknowledged record loses required payload/metadata under the selected declared fault model.

retained_requirements.title: Idempotent retry
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall resolve retries using scoped occurrence/idempotency identity while preserving distinct byte-identical occurrences.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Delivery repeats do not create duplicate occurrences; independent identical inputs retain separate origins.

retained_requirements.title: Crash recovery
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall recover staged work, committed records, outbox effects and consumer cursors without silent loss or repetition of committed effects.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Kill-point recovery reconstructs accepted records and resumes each cursor; unknown outcomes remain queryable.

retained_requirements.title: Bounded processing
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall bound queues, recursive parsing, query work and optional worker resources independently of raw intake.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Worker/parser overload stays within configured bounds and cannot stall admitted intake within its own declared budget.

retained_requirements.title: Admission and coverage
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall apply declared admission/backpressure/sampling policy and expose known or unknown acquisition gaps and losses.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Offered/admitted/rejected/dropped/unknown counts reconcile and no silent sampling occurs.

retained_requirements.title: Latency and throughput
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall meet a prospectively pinned capacity and latency profile including queueing, durability and stated concurrent reads/workers.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Profile P0 or P1 workload meets specified latency/throughput/memory criteria; no target is reported as achieved without evidence.

retained_requirements.title: No required model tokens
retained_requirements.statement: The mandatory intake, commit, registered-identity lookup and replay path shall require zero model inference calls and model tokens.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Instrumentation and dependency-failure checks observe zero model calls on that path; optional workers counted separately.

retained_requirements.title: Bounded evidence access
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall provide paginated source/time/region/part access with native precision, commit cursors and projection freshness.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Bounded queries retrieve exact requested retained evidence or explicit unavailable/limit status without full-history serialization.

retained_requirements.title: Availability and fault profiles
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall distinguish local recovery from replicated HA and expose acknowledgement/failover semantics for each supported profile.
retained_requirements.acceptance: P1 meets specified SLI/failover/RPO under pinned metadata-and-payload topology; minority/no-authority writes cannot diverge.

retained_requirements.title: Capacity expansion
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall support qualified expansion without changing evidence/identity semantics or requiring global per-observation identity scans.
retained_requirements.acceptance: N-to-2N experiment and hot-source/read-mix cases meet the declared expansion criterion or record the bottleneck.

retained_requirements.title: Retention and restoration
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall retain or explicitly retire payloads and their required schemas, configuration, calibration and identity dependencies under separate policies.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Restore reconstructs permitted retained evidence/identity; eviction or lost keys/decoders produces explicit unavailable status.

retained_requirements.title: Schema longevity
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall version schemas/profiles/descriptors, preserve unknown optional metadata and prohibit silent reinterpretation of historical fields.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Old/new readers round-trip supported extensions and reject unsupported critical interpretation while retaining native data.

retained_requirements.title: Identity uncertainty and conflict
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall keep reported, candidate and operationally accepted bindings distinct and prevent disputed equivalence propagation.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Adversarial fixture has no forced false merge; conflicts invalidate shortcuts; learned natural-data accuracy remains separately unqualified.

retained_requirements.title: Acquisition requests
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall execute supported acquisition-setting requests within declared capabilities and record requested/actual/denied/failed outcomes.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Repeated request IDs are accounted and commands, acknowledgements and measured outcomes remain distinct.

retained_requirements.title: Scope and parser isolation
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall enforce declared scope access and resource isolation for intake, query and optional decoders.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Cross-scope references are not joined without explicit authority and hostile nested input cannot exhaust the core.

retained_requirements.title: Operational accounting
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall expose complete outcome, coverage, lag, resource and cost accounting for eligible offered and admitted work.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Client and server accounting reconcile, outages cannot disappear from denominators, and worker cost is not omitted.

retained_requirements.title: Versioned policies
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall pin admission, retention, binding and processing policy versions needed to reconstruct a declared historical view.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Replaying the same committed prefix and policy gives the same bookkeeping view or declares a nondeterministic procedure/version.

retained_requirements.title: Derived-view compatibility
retained_requirements.statement: The layer shall version decoder/model/descriptor outputs and preserve their input selectors and compatibility limits.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A worker version change creates a new view and cannot silently mix incompatible descriptors.

retained_requirements.title: Host representations and distinguish state
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall host addressable representations of supplied structures and state, preserving modality/order/composition and qualitative or unquantified content without requiring a universal numeric or stock-flow encoding.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A mixed numeric/qualitative fixture retains distinct source content, represented state and explicit unknowns through creation and retrieval.

retained_requirements.title: Preserve identity, dependencies and revision lineage
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve internal identity, versioned dependencies and corrections without rewriting acquired evidence or equating internal representation identity with physical identity.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A false association can be retracted or split with prior as-of state and affected dependencies still inspectable.

retained_requirements.title: Distinguish interface and response properties
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall distinguish interaction boundary/participants, permitted exchange direction, hypothesized response polarity, loop behavior and uncertain causal status, including multi-party and mediated relations.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Directed, symmetric, unknown, multi-step and context-dependent examples remain distinguishable without promoting a directed exchange to causal proof.

retained_requirements.title: Host scoped interaction and transition rules
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall host declared or proposed interaction/update mechanisms with applicability, exchange or transformation semantics, constraints and unknowns; copying information shall not implicitly impose material-conservation rules.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A pinned mechanism distinguishes state, rate, signal and appropriate constraints, with unknown mechanics and unsupported causal claims retained explicitly.

retained_requirements.title: Preserve timing and history dependencies
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall retain event/receipt/model-time distinctions and history required by supported delayed/asynchronous mechanisms, including perception, response and delivery delays and declared numerical timing where applicable.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Same-current-observation/different-history fixtures, delayed updates and replay retain their distinctions and use no evidence unavailable at the recorded prediction time.

retained_requirements.title: Compose and inspect at declared scales
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall support reusable nested and overlapping views with cross-level dependencies, retaining access to evidence and declaring losses and validity limits of compression/abstraction.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A coarse view exposes its supporting detail and any task-consequential loss; structural resemblance alone does not qualify transfer.

retained_requirements.title: Preserve uncertainty and rival mechanisms
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve missing coverage, hidden-state uncertainty, conflicting and observationally indistinguishable explanations, including nonnumeric uncertainty, without treating unobserved as absent or imposing one scalar confidence.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Under insufficient evidence, alternatives remain distinct and unresolved; unknown values or coverage cannot silently become zero, false or independent confirmation.

retained_requirements.title: Trace evidence and imported assistance
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall trace received claims, transformations, producer/model versions, imported knowledge, shared evidence and subsequent outcomes so learned experience is distinguishable from externally supplied proposals and repeated derivations.
retained_requirements.acceptance: An assisted proposal retains lineage and shared-evidence dependence; prospective controls can isolate the declared retained/native contribution.

retained_requirements.title: Revise context and scope
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall support revisable context, regime and boundary hypotheses, preserving unknown external drivers and distinguishing the actual acquisition/action boundary from modeled world scopes.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A previously supported relation can be narrowed, widened or invalidated under changed context without erasing earlier evidence or asserting a unique hidden cause.

retained_requirements.title: Expose inquiry selection and stopping
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose evidence, assumptions, selection/exposure history and candidate alternatives needed for bounded inquiry and discriminating tests; scheduling policy and its objectives shall be declared at the relevant component boundary.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Inspection can identify selection bias and a credible challenge; inquiry can defer, stop or revisit on declared grounds without forcing equal credibility or constant model calls.

retained_requirements.title: Separate trials, committed changes and authority
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall distinguish candidate/simulation state, committed internal state, observation evidence and measured external outcomes; versioned changes shall have explicit type, authority, concurrency and failure semantics.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Stale or unauthorized trial updates cannot overwrite evidence or commit effects; state/parameter/structure/policy/goal changes remain attributable and distinct.

retained_requirements.title: Enable accountable reorganization
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall permit supported creation, deletion/retirement, split, merge and rewiring of organization and explicit proposed mechanisms, retaining dependencies, history and declared irreversibility/loss.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A revised organization can be inspected against its predecessor, affected derivations are handled, and the origin of generative/selection rules remains explicit.

retained_requirements.title: Keep goals and outcome criteria explicit
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall preserve inferred function, supplied task, inquiry objective, operational constraints and evaluation criteria as distinct versioned concepts; proposed changes shall not silently weaken acceptance or promote activity proxies to success.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A proposal that lowers a threshold, increases question count or changes a goal cannot be reported as improved prediction/task performance under unchanged criteria.

retained_requirements.title: Bound shared resources and account for complete costs
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose and enforce its declared storage/access/update budgets and backpressure with a defined owner, including costs and failures of inquiry/model dependencies under the selected operating profile.
retained_requirements.acceptance: A pinned workload accounts for offered/admitted/rejected work, failed calls and all relevant costs; saturation has bounded explicit behavior.

retained_requirements.title: Preserve recoverable organization under declared retention
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall provide declared durability/recovery and loss semantics, with inspectable retention/compression decisions that consider rare but relevant structures and recovery needs rather than frequency alone.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Fault and context-change fixtures expose what survives, what is lost and why; no universal retention, perfect reversibility or HA guarantee is inferred.

retained_requirements.title: Support reproducible prospective assessment
retained_requirements.statement: The substrate shall expose configurations, assumptions, initial states, available evidence and candidate outcomes needed to test conditional predictions and revisions prospectively, separating model response, future-driver assumptions, numerical semantics and actual observations.
retained_requirements.acceptance: Pinned candidate tests and appropriate unchanged/alternative/assistance controls retain full outcomes; simulation agreement or historical fit alone cannot establish causal identification, transfer or intelligence.

consumer_obligations.statement: Consumers shall distinguish received claims and derived interpretations from independently validated facts.
Consumers shall preserve unknown identity/time/coverage and shall not infer absence from an unobserved interval.
Consumers shall respect valid-time, known-at and policy versions and process identity corrections without rewriting raw evidence.
Consumers shall retrieve retained evidence through bounded selectors/cursors and handle explicit unavailable or truncated results.
Consumers shall declare imported model/feature experience and avoid silently mixing incompatible derived spaces.
Consumers requesting selective acquisition shall state target/settings/budget and retain selection lineage; inquiry value is a later-layer responsibility.
Consumers shall use the requested durability/commit level and must not treat a staged receipt as recoverable committed knowledge.
Consumers shall account for full-task tokens/cost, including retrieval and failed calls, before claiming an efficiency advantage.

cases.title: Mixed native capture and duplicate payloads.
cases.acceptance: Text, image, waveform, structured numeric and an unknown composite retain byte hashes, order and distinct genuine occurrences; replayed notification does not duplicate an occurrence.

cases.title: Restart between byte staging and metadata commit.
cases.acceptance: No false durable receipt, no missing acknowledged artifact, detectable/recoverable orphan or incomplete manifest, and no repeated committed occurrence.

cases.title: Long-gap identity and source epoch reset.
cases.acceptance: Stable binding survives a simulated two-year interval; replacement/reset is explicit; ambiguous physical continuity remains unknown rather than silently merged.

cases.title: Cross-modal false association and reversal.
cases.acceptance: Similar text/image candidates do not force a merge; split/correction preserves sources and invalidates dependent views.

cases.title: Event versus structure and source dependence.
cases.acceptance: Direct structural inspection and reported event are represented on independent role/basis axes; rephrased copies remain one source lineage.

cases.title: Temporal semantics, late arrival and actor visibility.
cases.acceptance: Known-at cuts exclude later reports; gaps and uncertain time persist; actors cannot use analyst-only or future information.

cases.title: Units, ordinal values and conversions.
cases.acceptance: Incompatible dimensional equations are rejected; allowed conversions retain meaning; ordinal/unknown values are not silently treated as numeric or zero.

cases.title: Composition and overlapping system views.
cases.acceptance: Shared referent/resource appears once in accounting; query boundaries and external input closure remain explicit.

cases.title: Multi-input nonlinear law.
cases.acceptance: One joint mechanism with domain/rivals is retained; unsupported independent edge coefficients are not substituted.

cases.title: Stock-flow accounting and shared constraints.
cases.acceptance: Transfers balance under declared conversions/losses and capacity is consumed once; conflicting simultaneous demand is resolved by the declared rule.

cases.title: Delays, backlog and state carry-over.
cases.acceptance: Same visible stock with different pending commitments gives the appropriately different forecast; topology change preserves relevant backlog.

cases.title: Loop closure, sign and changing dominance.
cases.acceptance: Open paths are not labeled complete loops; sign is conditional; saturated or dormant mechanisms do not retain an unsupported fixed gain.

cases.title: Scope/interpretation and stakeholder criteria.
cases.acceptance: Causal scope, interests, qualitative concerns, local/wider horizons and disagreements remain distinct; no compulsory global utility is invented.

cases.title: Rival mechanism and non-identifiability.
cases.acceptance: Several structures fitting present data remain alternatives; the system proposes a distinguishing observation or reports non-identifiability.

cases.title: Curiosity against noisy novelty.
cases.acceptance: Test selection favors feasible useful discrimination over uninformative random noise; heuristic utility is not presented as calibrated information gain.

cases.title: System-of-systems boundary expansion.
cases.acceptance: Consequential interface frontier is exposed one supported link at a time; omitted drivers and duplicate accounting are detected; resource ceilings cause explicit defer/truncation.

cases.title: Restricted compilation and unsupported laws.
cases.acceptance: Invalid operators/references/units or missing backend capability fail before execution; a qualitative unknown does not generate a precise fabricated trajectory.

cases.title: Numerical refinement and discontinuity.
cases.acceptance: Solutions stabilize under declared step/tolerance refinement, balance diagnostics and threshold-event fixtures; unsupported delay/DAE semantics are explicit.

cases.title: Hybrid event and shared clock.
cases.acceptance: Event ties, continuous advancement, resource contention and pending updates follow one pinned policy without double application.

cases.title: Prospective forecast seal and outcome correspondence.
cases.acceptance: Original model/cut/forecast/scoring rule is immutable; new independent outcomes match quantities/units/time; edited forecasts cannot replace old ones.

cases.title: Synthetic evidence echo through a full loop.
cases.acceptance: Generated, summarized, exported and reimported simulation artifacts remain generated and cannot become independent corroboration.

cases.title: Calibration, missing outcomes and uncertainty.
cases.acceptance: Missing/censored data remain explicit; numeric scores are only computed for declared suitable quantities; coverage claims state dependence/stationarity assumptions.

cases.title: Error diagnosis and controlled revision.
cases.acceptance: Numerical, source, semantic, driver, parameter, rule and topology explanations remain distinguishable; revision records rationale and affected dependencies.

cases.title: Repair and finite shared support.
cases.acceptance: Repair uses the same resource authority as competing work, takes time and can fail; stable output with eroding restorative capacity remains visible.

cases.title: Real reorganization versus model correction.
cases.acceptance: Membership/rewiring history, actual-world evidence and model reinterpretation have different operation types and preserve state.

cases.title: Bounded actor response and failed execution.
cases.acceptance: Intention uses perceived options; realized effects obey actual modeled capacity; no automatic optimal response or goal success is assumed.

cases.title: Eight traps, leverage and adverse transitions.
cases.acceptance: Trap labels require mechanism evidence/rivals; interventions specify direction, adoption, time/resources, carry-over and wider/adverse consequences.

cases.title: Policy monitoring, authority and standard integrity.
cases.acceptance: Fixed response, amendment proposal, adoption and analyst revision stay separate; refusal/defer is possible; old criteria cannot be silently weakened.

cases.title: Action dispatch and uncertain completion.
cases.acceptance: Unauthorized dispatch is denied; idempotent reconciliation prevents duplicate permitted effects; a receipt remains distinct from observed effect.

cases.title: Proactive strategic finding.
cases.acceptance: A configured internal finding carries novel decision relevance, mechanism/evidence chain, uncertainty, horizon and test suggestion; duplicates are suppressed without masking a material update.

cases.title: Selective acquisition and bias.
cases.acceptance: Selection/exposure/cost lineage is preserved; unvisited or unavailable evidence is not treated as absent or as confirmation.

cases.title: Schema/embedding migration and stale projection.
cases.acceptance: Incompatible versions are rejected or explicitly migrated; old/current views do not silently mix; authoritative cutoff queries bypass or expose stale indexes.

cases.title: Retention and restore.
cases.acceptance: Tombstones and unavailable refs propagate; acknowledged data and forecasts restore with their histories at a declared coherent point.

cases.title: Queue saturation and model outage.
cases.acceptance: Native intake stays within the declared capacity/spool profile; bounded reasoning yields; overload and freshness lag remain visible and counted.

cases.title: Lease fencing, duplicate/reorder and concurrent revision.
cases.acceptance: A stale worker or stale base revision cannot overwrite a newer commit; unknown completion is reconciled and outputs remain idempotent.

cases.title: Matched persistent-learning comparison.
cases.acceptance: Same base model, observations/tools and accounting; include reset, unrelated and conventional-memory controls; report all pinned outcomes without a predetermined winner.

cases.title: Failure to fit or transfer under regime shift.
cases.acceptance: New operating point/parameters/rules/topology/input/measurement are challenged separately; unsupported transfer is withheld and failures remain logged.

cases.title: Whole-path resource accounting.
cases.acceptance: Offered/admitted/failing work, all token/media/tool/retry costs and wall time reconcile; unknown usage is not zero; energy claims require instrumentation.

cases.title: HA fault-domain and partition profile.
cases.acceptance: Only under an implemented HA1 topology: eligible request, durability, fencing, byte/reference consistency and failover results satisfy the pinned SLO/RPO/RTO and fault conditions.

cases.title: Provider/backend replacement.
cases.acceptance: Alternate provider or engine respects the same record/status/permission semantics; a version or quality change reopens qualification rather than silently inheriting results.

cases.title: Incremental correctness and locality under store growth.
cases.acceptance: At the FAST1 sizes, delta/retraction and incremental views match a separately recomputed authoritative reference for the same cutoff; record actual touched work and warm/cold latency. Q1/Q2 and growth targets apply only to their declared operation shapes.

cases.title: Fast decision quality, batching and escalation.
cases.acceptance: Compare Jev, deterministic and appropriate small/generative alternatives on matched bounded contexts; pin selective error/calibration and coverage before exposure. Include missing correct option, dependence between questions, OOD inputs and timeouts. No model output bypasses deterministic constraints.

cases.title: Global fan-out and stale-cache containment.
cases.acceptance: A high-degree/shared driver invalidates all declared dependents; bounded processing exposes remaining backlog. A warm stale cached result cannot be silently returned as fresh or used beyond its permitted policy.

cases.title: Coarse/fine abstraction and nonlinear aggregation.
cases.acceptance: Refinement bridges preserve units, time, identity, resource/count semantics and commitments. Demonstrate valid coarse reuse and a counterexample where heterogeneity/thresholds require refinement; compare supported output ranges.

cases.title: Missing access, standing grants and request fatigue.
cases.acceptance: Reuse an existing scoped grant; create an evidence-specific missing-access request; coalesce duplicates; honor denial/expiry; enforce notification policy and record useful/inconclusive acquisition outcomes.

cases.title: Breadth and depth expansion in one evolving world.
cases.acceptance: Start with forest observations, add an adjacent logging/market view and internal insect-life-stage evidence without resetting history or duplicating shared referents/resources. Retain unsupported biological mechanisms and update only justified bridges.

cases.title: Long-running growth, corrections and maintenance.
cases.acceptance: Reconnect sources, revise identity/rules, compact/reindex, retain/evict evidence and recover a pinned model cut while the store grows. Bound active memory/queues and count full maintenance/storage costs and unavailable evidence.

cases.title: End-to-end useful speed and inquiry yield.
cases.acceptance: Measure capture/model freshness, eligible useful response latency, validated-answer time, escalation coverage, exploration benefit and complete cost under FAST1/DEV1. Include correct abstention and failed inquiries; an acknowledgement-only or omission-driven speedup does not pass.
